# Fixture — top-level `0002-grand` decoy

A committed test fixture, not a real work item. It is a top-level item whose name
collides with a bare `MMMM-slug` token used below the root, so the guard can prove
sibling-first resolution prefers the depth-2 parent's row over this top-level
decoy.
